title: Two writers, two locking disciplines, one host-global ledger at fleet width 2
summary: Pre-existing, surfaced by the cycle-1571 review sweep. subagent/run.go's writeSubprocessLedger appends with a bare O_APPEND and no lock, and writes ledger.tip through a FIXED tmp path (run.go ~:574-592), while adapters/ledger.Append serializes on flock. Both target the same host-global .evolve/ledger.jsonl, which is symlinked into every lane worktree. At fleet width 2+ that is a torn-write / lost-tip hazard on a hash-chained file whose whole value is that it cannot be silently rewritten. Also unescaped: run.go passes e.ArtifactSHA256 and prevHash to %s without jsonStringEscape, unlike their sibling fields (pre-existing; adjacent to the format-verb class already fixed). Fix: route the subagent writer through the same locked append path, or give it the same flock + atomic-tip discipline.
